goals: Test whether the system can manage rental plans by adding, removing, and unallowing rental ranges based on specific scenarios.
Verify that when updating the endpoint of the last range, a new range is created.
Verify that when removing the last day range, only one day range is left and the endpoint of the last day range displays '--'.
Verify that when updating the endpoint of the last range, a new hour range is created.
Verify that when removing the last hour range, only one hour range is left and the endpoint of the last hour range displays '24'.
